U.S. ARMY - MOSS

Army ASVAB Scores

Minimum AFQT, how line scores work, and the score needed for every entry-level MOS

Minimum AFQT: 31

The Army requires an AFQT of at least 31 to enlist. Applicants who score 21 to 30 can sometimes enlist through the Future Soldier Preparatory Course, which helps them raise their score before training.

How the Army Scores Jobs

The Army combines your ASVAB section scores into 10 line scores. Each MOS sets a minimum on one or two of them, so your line scores decide which jobs are open to you.

CodeScoreMade from
GTGeneral TechnicalVE + AR
CLClericalVE + AR + MK
COCombatAR + AS + MC
ELElectronicsGS + AR + MK + EI
FAField ArtilleryAR + MK + MC
GMGeneral MaintenanceGS + AS + MK + EI
MMMechanical MaintenanceAS + MC + EI
OFOperators and FoodVE + AS + MC
SCSurveillance and CommunicationsVE + AR + AS + MC
STSkilled TechnicalGS + VE + MK + MC

Army line scores average 100, and most people score between 60 and 140. Besides the main sections listed, the Army formula gives a small weight to your other sections too.
